reader_summary.headline: Erik is the CEO of Stable Asset Management.
reader_summary.overview: Erik is the CEO of Stable Asset Management. Unusually, Stable’s strategy focuses on other investing firms. They look to back the Blackstone's of tomorrow and provide those founders with capital and support so their time is spent doing what they do best.

key_points.text: Erik is the CEO of Stable Asset Management.
They look to back the Blackstone's of tomorrow and provide those founders with capital and support so their time is spent doing what they do best.
We discuss the commonalities among promising founders in this sector, how Stable serves as a full resource to their companies.
